description: A shell script for bumping kernel versions within an OpenWrt repository, handling git operations, configuration migration, and version management.

methods.name: _msg
methods.description: Outputs a message with a specified level, handling variable arguments.

methods.name: e_err
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Restores git state and cleans up temporary branches.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes script environment, checks repository state, and sets variables.

methods.name: bump_kernel
methods.description: Performs the kernel version bump, including git operations and configuration updates.

methods.name: check_requirements
methods.description: Checks for required external commands and reports missing ones.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, parses options, performs checks, and orchestrates the bump process.
